subject: Upcoming Company Event: Summer Picnic
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce our upcoming company event - the annual Summer Picnic! It will be held on Saturday, July 24th at Central Park. Join us for a fun-filled day of games, food, and camaraderie. Please RSVP by July 10th so we can make necessary arrangements. Looking forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Your Name]
